reuse.why: Leaves the shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend (already taking the enable flag and used by all weekend paths) unchanged and writes the daily skip as an inline loop in getNextDate, skipping the helper for daily schedules.

duplication.why: The five-part daily-weekend condition is written twice and the occurrences/isWeekend fetch is re-done in a loop, alongside the existing first fetch.

placement.why: Right module, but placed in one consumer rather than in the shared weekend helper that getUpcomingDates and schedule-template call.

scope.why: Focused on getNextDate and one test; it does not reach the other weekend paths.

maintainability.why: Magic 370-iteration loop, repeated compound condition, frequency read from dateCond.value, and daily schedules still move weekends in getUpcomingDates and schedule-template.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getNextDate in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts guards getDateWithSkippedWeekend with `!isDaily` and implements the skip inline instead of extending the helper

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated condition and fetch are literal copies, not disguised.

one_place.where: Only getNextDate skips daily weekend occurrences; server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and server/budget/schedule-template.ts still move them through getDateWithSkippedWeekend.
